meta.name: chrome-automation
meta.description: 网页开发工程师与运营专员在需要自动化现有 Chrome 浏览器时必用！通过 CDP 协议无缝接管当前浏览器，自动配置环境并实时可视化执行任务。完美保留登录状态，一键完成复杂网页自动化流程，让繁琐操作自动化。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接管当前 Chrome 自动完成网页操作，保留登录状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要在网页上重复执行操作且需要保留登录状态。
copy.tagline_en: Automate tedious web flows in an existing Chrome with login preserved.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you routinely repeat manual steps in a browser and need to stay logged in.

howto.what: 通过 CDP 协议接管你本机的 Chrome,在浏览器窗口里实时打开页面、截图、点选填表,并自动安装 agent-browser 等依赖;登录状态会保留,无需反复登录。
howto.when: 当你要求用现有 Chrome 做网页自动化时会接管,例如打开某站点、填表单、截图等;动手前会先跑自动安装脚本检查依赖。

say.text: 帮我在 Chrome 里打开小红书搜索 labubu,并截图给我
say.note: 会启动保留登录状态的 Chrome 执行

say.text: 用我的 Chrome 打开这个表单页,按字段填好并提交
say.note: 先 snapshot 取元素引用再填写

say.text: 检查一下 agent-browser 环境装好了没
say.note: 运行安装脚本并输出版本验证

howto.what_en: It takes over your own Chrome via CDP and runs web automation in the browser window: opening pages, taking screenshots, filling forms, and auto-installing agent-browser dependencies. Login states are preserved.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to automate your existing Chrome, e.g. opening a site, filling a form or taking a screenshot; it first runs the auto-install script to check dependencies.

say_en.text: Open Xiaohongshu in my Chrome, search for labubu, and send me a screenshot
Open this form page in my Chrome, fill the fields, and submit
Check whether the agent-browser environment is installed
say_en.note: Runs install script and prints version
